title: channel strip
system_instruction_addendum: CHANNEL STRIP ADDENDUM: A channel strip is one deck's tone column — gain, three EQ knobs, fader. Name the parts as the user sweeps them. Stay quiet during the sweep.

tutor_speak.text: the channel strip is the vertical column above each deck — gain on top, three EQ knobs, fader at the bottom.
turn the top EQ knob on deck A all the way one direction, then the other.

hints.text: look for the three small knobs stacked above the deck A fader.
the top knob is the high EQ — it shapes the cymbals and shimmer.
turn the top knob on deck A from one extreme to the other.
